author: CritLoren, modified by fourdogslong
name: MD3 High Contrast
description: The high-contrast variant of the Material Design 3 inspired theme, pairing a near-black interface with bright text for maximum legibility.
notes: Ships as a zip instead of a single css file: extract it into the themes folder so md3-high-contrast.css and its md3 folder sit side by side. The theme also imports darktable's stock darktable.css, so copy that file from your darktable installation into the same themes folder.
